dataDirectorySecurity.title: Application data directory needs attention
dataDirectorySecurity.description: The application data directory permissions are unsafe. Some operations may be blocked. It stores application settings, the database, and runtime data, so it must be accessible only to the application owner. Permissions that are too broad can expose data; permissions that are too strict can prevent the application from working.
dataDirectorySecurity.unavailable: The application data directory is unavailable or could not be checked. Some operations may be blocked. Make sure the directory exists, its disk is mounted, and the account running the app can access it.
dataDirectorySecurity.whyPermissions: Why are the permissions important? The .narrafork directory contains this machine's application data. Restricting it to the owner helps prevent other users on the machine from reading or modifying that data while still allowing the application service to work normally.
dataDirectorySecurity.manual: Automatic repair is unavailable. An administrator must handle the directory manually. On Windows, make sure the data directory is a normal folder (not a broken junction or mapped drive) and grant Full Control to the account running the app. On Unix, restrict the directory to owner access only (700).
dataDirectorySecurity.inconclusive: The check did not finish, so the directory's state is unknown. This usually means the disk or filesystem was slow to respond; it does not indicate a permission problem. You can check again later.
dataDirectorySecurity.queryFailed: The check could not complete (the network or service did not respond), so the directory's state is unknown. This does not indicate a permission problem. Please check again later.
dataDirectorySecurity.confirmMessage: This only restricts the application data directory itself to 700 (owner access only). It does not recurse, delete files, or change your home directory. Other operating-system users may lose access.
dataDirectorySecurity.success: Directory permissions repaired. Please retry your original operation manually.
dataDirectorySecurity.repairFailed: Repair did not complete successfully. Check again or handle the directory manually.
